10%
of positive net membership profit

More than stories. More books in children's hands.

We believe every child deserves the joy of holding a book of their own. That's why we plan to reserve ten percent of positive net membership profit to help fund free printed books for children and families, distributing them as funds and opportunities allow.

Free printed books are part of our giving mission, not a benefit guaranteed to each member. The number and timing of distributions depend on available funds and practical arrangements.
